name.en: Sea cave coastal rock-face teaching module
name.zh: 海蚀洞海岸岩壁教学模块

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: horizontal wave-cut opening at the base of a coastal rock face. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：海岸岩壁底部的横向浪蚀洞口。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Rocky Coast Landforms
sources.supports: Sea stacks, wave-cut platforms, sea caves and raised coastal features
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original3.5m-wide representative coastal wall with an eroded low broad entrance, real thick roof/side walls/floor and a short blind cavity with solid rear. Whole volume modeled as one continuous surface from exterior face into the recess, not an old arch sealed by a plug. NPS supports basic sea-cave context; blind layout, local proportions, fracture simplification and palette are art choices. No copied real coast, ancient locality, exact rock age, fluid simulation or included water.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创3.5米宽代表海岸岩壁，具低宽浪蚀入口、真实厚顶、侧壁、底面及短盲腔后壁。外岩面至洞腔为连续整体曲面，不是旧石拱加塞封堵。NPS支持基本海蚀洞背景；盲腔布局、局部比例、简化裂面及配色为美术设定。不复制具体海岸，不主张古地点、精确岩龄或流体模拟，不混入水体。

claim_scope: Original stylized geological/mineral/process concept, not exact site reconstruction or a named organism.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
